smoke_gate.expansion_rule: Expand to the frozen eight-environment pilot only if runtime and receipt checks pass, at least one target environment passes locality, and the candidate is not redundant with motion_region_event_phase_lag on all locality-admitted target comparisons.

selection_rationale: The r25 work orders request motion_region_event_phase_curvature for both cloth_move and stack_cube, the largest remaining shared mechanism-specific gap after stage 3.

The predecessor phase-lag probe measures a first temporal difference of action-event salience; the successor measures a normalized second difference, adding curvature rather than rescaling the same response direction.
Spatial motion masking, first-conditioned-latent preservation, current-noisy-latent preservation, and action immutability remain unchanged, isolating the new temporal derivative order.
Probe selection uses work-order coverage and algebraic non-equivalence only; no target-local primitive benefit label is used.
post_collection_rule: If the smoke gate admits expansion, collect the remaining six environments under the same campaign, build the atlas, replace only motion_region_reweight's required path in the cumulative affinity, and rerun the unchanged selector plan, effect-label index, transfer certificate, and collision labels.
claim_boundary: This stage tests whether event-phase curvature supplies missing local diagnostic coverage. It is not model-improvement evidence and cannot by itself establish selector superiority or transfer safety.
